fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-06-30 at roughly 21:50, it was reported that a person offering to buy an item listed online asked the complainant to approve a UPI request, following which Rs. 7,500 was withdrawn. The online submission was made by Divya Sekar (9000000371). The account reference SYN-ACC-100067 linked to the complainant was mentioned in relation to the transactions. A person named Karthik Shankar, associated with the number 9000000306, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Potentially relevant material referenced includes digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent QR code allegedly shared under the pretext of a refund.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, mobile number, shopping complex, night, bank account, digital document, suspect
